name: ICELAND-FAROE GAP
description: A diesel-electric submarine is approaching the Iceland–Faroe barrier. Two escorts, a Virginia-class submarine and patrol aircraft detached to Keflavik must deny its southern exit. The route and six-hour deadline define the game problem. Water deepens sharply south of the Iceland–Faroe Ridge, where a deep winter mixed layer and convergence zones shape the acoustic picture. Real geography and real platform families; the conflict, the deployment and the tactical situation are fiction.

map.anchor_note: World coordinates are nautical miles about this point; one minute of latitude is one mile and longitude is scaled by the cosine of the anchor latitude.

objectives.text: Deny passage for six hours, or neutralize the transiting submarine. A breakout loses the watch.

forces: NATO: 1 attack submarine, 1 destroyer, 1 frigate, Keflavik patrol det  ·  Russia: 1 diesel submarine
